title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
summary: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

title: The 'Largest Pure-Play' XRP Treasury Is About to Go Public
summary: Shareholders approved Evernorth's merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, clearing the way for the Ripple-backed firm to begin trading Oct. 8 with a stash of roughly 473 million XRP.

title: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut
summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholders approved the Evernorth merger. The XRP treasury company expects to hold ~473M XRP.
